lines: Welcome to a complete walkthrough of the Apex Technology compensation plan. We'll cover every rank, every override level, and real examples of what you can earn.
Let's start with the big picture. On the Technology side, you earn by putting Apex's A.I. tools in the hands of businesses.
It's open to everyone — no license required — and it costs nothing to get started.
First, one essential term: Business Volume, or B.V.
For every product, Apex designates a Business Volume — and that B.V. is simply the amount your commission is based on.
Here are the real numbers. Docs2Video ranges from nine B.V. on the starter plan up to a hundred twenty-two on enterprise.
SmartViewz carries sixty-nine B.V., and SmartViewz Lite thirty-two. Every product has its own designated B.V.
Now, how you get paid. You earn two ways — and this is the heart of the plan.
Way one: a commission on the B.V. of every product you personally sell.
Way two: override income — a share that comes back to you as the team you build makes sales too.
Do both, and your income compounds — what you sell, plus what your whole team sells.
Your earning power grows with your rank. There are nine ranks, from Starter to Elite.
Each rank has a target: your own personal volume, plus your team's group volume. Hit both, and you promote.
Let's walk them. Starter is where everyone begins — no requirements, earning on your first level.
Bronze: a hundred fifty personal, three hundred group. Reach it and earn a two hundred fifty dollar bonus.
Silver: five hundred personal, fifteen hundred group — and a one thousand dollar rank bonus.
Gold: twelve hundred personal, five thousand group, plus one sponsored Bronze. The bonus jumps to three thousand.
Platinum: twenty-five hundred personal, fifteen thousand group, two sponsored Silvers — a seventy-five hundred dollar bonus.
Ruby: four thousand personal, thirty thousand group, two sponsored Golds — a twelve thousand dollar bonus.
Diamond: five thousand personal, fifty thousand group — an eighteen thousand dollar bonus.
Crown: six thousand personal, seventy-five thousand group — a twenty-two thousand dollar bonus.
And Elite, the top: eight thousand personal, a hundred twenty thousand group — a thirty thousand dollar bonus.
Add every rank bonus together, and that's more than ninety-three thousand dollars in bonuses along the way.
Now the override schedule — how deep, and how much, you earn on your team.
Level one is your enrollment override. It pays thirty percent on everyone you personally bring in — always thirty, at every rank.
Beyond level one, higher ranks unlock deeper levels. Starter earns on one level. Elite earns on all seven.
Here's the full schedule. As you climb, you unlock levels two through seven — and at Ruby and above, you earn on the entire pool.
A quick clarification on those levels. Your income comes from two connected trees.
Your enrollment tree pays that thirty percent level-one override on everyone you personally sponsor.
Your team tree pays levels two through seven, deeper into your organization, based on your rank.
And no one is paid twice for the same sale. Each level is counted once, cleanly.
Let's make it real with an example. Say you personally sell ten SmartViewz subscriptions in a month.
That's six hundred ninety B.V. in personal sales — your personal commission is paid on all of it.
Now add a team. Say twenty active people each producing around three hundred B.V. a month.
That's six thousand team B.V. flowing up through your override levels — income on top of your own.
Let's look at a realistic first ninety days. Month one — you focus on your own sales and hit your first personal volume.
Month two — you sponsor a few people, your group volume climbs, and you promote to Bronze. That's your first rank bonus.
Month three — your team is producing, you reach Silver, and now you're earning three levels deep. Momentum is real.
Notice the pattern: personal sales fund your start, and your team turns it into something that compounds.
To earn those overrides, one simple rule: produce at least fifty personal volume each month.
Sell a little, stay qualified. Miss a month, and you have a thirty-day grace period to get back on track.
And your highest rank is permanent — once you reach it, that achievement is yours for life.
So that's the Technology plan: sell the tools, build a team, and climb — nine ranks, seven levels deep, no ceiling.
Start today, stay consistent, and let the plan reward every step. Welcome to Apex.
